name: Mycelium
desc: A fungal colony feeding — apical hyphae split, fuse and thread outward through a nutrient field, then autolyse behind the advancing margin as the medium is exhausted, so the network perpetually colonises, starves, dies back and recolonises the plate.

energy.doc: hyphal extension rate, nutrient uptake and exposure

speed.doc: rate multiplier on growth and process time
